name: Harnefer
title: The Descendant in the Tribe of Asher
summary: Harnefer is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of the tribe of Asher. He is known only through his genealogy and has no prominent narrative role in the Bible, but his name is preserved as part of Israel's tribal records.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Harnefer is listed among the descendants of Asher in 1 Chronicles, as part of the detailed tribal registers kept after the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher and Its Lineages
keyEvents.description: The genealogy of the tribe of Asher was carefully recorded to preserve the tribe's identity and inheritance rights in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Harnefer
keyEvents.description: Harnefer's sons are listed as part of the brave warriors and heads of the tribe of Asher, showing the significance of his family.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher as a Warrior People
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Asher, including the line of Harnefer, were described as skilled warriors and leaders of their clans, ready for battle.
